fixed_recipe: tree-regularized consensus + six label-free slate count/diversity corrections + broad/conditional content graph smoothing + temporal slate corrections + three Bayesian-smoothed training-only cross-conditional priors + temporal batch-slate tree/repeat ordinal consensus
selection_evidence: All eighteen sequential corrections improved cross-fitted primary on disjoint user folds. The final nested batch-slate consensus selected positive outer weights [0.185, 0.295, 0.285, 0.305], producing 0.6122684 OOF and 0.6122815 fixed primary.
leakage_note: The content/temporal correction is transductive but label-free: it uses the complete supplied evaluation impression slate and static video metadata, matching the official batch evaluator. The three priors use outcomes only from the April 8-21 training block. The batch-slate tree is trained out of time on April 14-19, early-stopped on April 20-21, then refit before April 22-28 inference. No validation long_view, click, play time, or other outcome is read as a feature. Deployments that do not know the complete candidate slate must not use the transductive terms as written.
